summary: 24 runs of >= 3 days: 15 confirmed, 2 partial, 7 unconfirmed. Every run of >= 8 days (7 events) is a documented spacecraft or instrument safe mode / maneuver / GPS anomaly. The unconfirmed runs are all 3-5 days and add at most 1 203 (Jul 2002) and 1 008 (May-Jun 2024) VIIRS-equivalent hotspots of gap fill; the others 0-60. Short runs of 1-2 days (95 Terra, 52 Aqua, 3 SNPP) were not cross-checked: the MODAPS tables list hundreds of sub-day EDOS/L0 outages and a day with partial coverage can read as zero in a low-fire month.
